args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 was also healthy, but older).
- Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`), and the service is now **healthy** with a 0.2% error rate.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0", describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so if you later want to redeploy it, that would require change-manager approval per policy.
